observations: Photo 0: Industrial machine, teal/green and cream-white body, mounted on casters, placed outdoors on bare ground near a wall. Top section has multiple black metal clamp/feeder arms arranged in a row. Front has a sloped feed tray/output chute in reddish-brown metal. A man in dark clothing stands beside it, back turned.
Photo 0: Visible wear - rust spots on the feed tray, scattered paper scraps and dust on the machine, drive wheel/pulley visible on left side.

Photo 1: Same type of machine viewed from a different angle, indoors against a pale blue wall with window. Control panel on left side with round buttons and dial, red/green switch toggle, yellow caution sticker below panel.
Photo 1: Clear plastic safety guard/hood raised over the central mechanism. Output conveyor/tray extends to the right. Floor is bare concrete, another machine partly visible in bottom right corner.
Both photos carry a watermark reading 'OYOLAKFOM NIGLTD - POSTED ON JIJI', which identifies the seller/listing platform, not the machine's manufacturer.
